trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: OM Bank - Data Analyst
Company: Old Mutual
About the company: Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this. At OM Bank, we strive to attract great people who are passionate about coming together for a higher purpose, building something unique and aspirational, and always aiming to be the best they can be. We are rooted in our purpose of inspiring and enabling our customers to grow and sustain their prosperity.
Purpose of the role: This role is responsible for supporting data driven decision making across the business by analysing, interpreting, and reporting on data from various sources. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to understand information needs, produce meaningful insights, and develop reporting solutions that help improve customer outcomes, business performance, and operational efficiency. The Data Analyst will be responsible for collecting, preparing, and validating data, creating reports and dashboards, monitoring key performance indicators, and identifying trends and opportunities within the data. The role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non technical audiences. The successful candidate will contribute to building a culture of evidence based decision making by transforming data into actionable insights that support business objectives and strategic priorities. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop analytical, reporting, and stakeholder engagement skills within a fast growing and innovative banking environment.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  - Perform exploratory analysis to answer business questions and support decision making.
  - Translate data findings into clear and actionable business insights.
  - Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and scorecards.
  - Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, relevant, and aligned with business requirements.
  - Present findings in a clear and easy to understand manner for both technical and non technical audiences.
  - Collect, clean, validate, and prepare data for analysis and reporting purposes.
  - Assist in maintaining data quality by identifying inconsistencies, gaps, and anomalies.
  - Work with data owners to resolve data quality issues where required.
  - Engage with stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements.
  - Translate business needs into reporting specifications and analytical outputs.
  - Support the development of measurement frameworks and key performance indicators.
  - Support business teams by identifying opportunities for operational and customer experience improvements through data analysis.
  - Monitor business performance metrics and highlight significant changes or emerging trends.
  - Contribute to evidence based recommendations that support business objectives.
  - Follow data governance, privacy, and security standards when handling data.
  - Ensure data used for reporting and analysis meets defined quality and compliance requirements.
  - Maintain clear documentation of reports, data sources, and business definitions.
  - Build positive working relationships with internal stakeholders.
  - Respond to reporting requests and provide analytical support to business users.
  - Assist in communicating analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
  - Develop knowledge of analytical tools, reporting platforms, and banking products.
  - Stay informed about emerging trends and best practices in data analytics and business intelligence.
  - Participate in training and continuous learning opportunities to build analytical capability.
Must-have requirements:
  - Relevant qualification in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Preferably Bachelors Degree.
  - 1 to 2 years experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar analytical role.
  - Experience working with Power BI.
  - Experience using SQL for data extraction and analysis.
Nice-to-have:
  - Exposure to Python, R, or other analytical tools would be advantageous.
  - Experience within the banking or financial services industry would be advantageous.
Location: Johannesburg
Closing date: 2026-11-05
Employment equity statement: The appointment will be made from the designated group in line with the Employment Equity Plan of Old Mutual South Africa and the specific business unit in question.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Data Analyst

Old Mutual

Johannesburg

About us
Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this. At OM Bank, we strive to attract great people who are passionate about coming together for a higher purpose, building something unique and aspirational, and always aiming to be the best they can be. We are rooted in our purpose of inspiring and enabling our customers to grow and sustain their prosperity.

About the role
You will support data driven decision making across OM Bank by analysing, interpreting and reporting on data from a range of sources. Working closely with business stakeholders, you will turn their information needs into insights, dashboards and reports that improve customer outcomes, business performance and operational efficiency. The role is a chance to build your analytical, reporting and stakeholder engagement skills in a growing banking environment.

What you'll do
• Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities, and run exploratory analysis to answer business questions.
• Translate findings into clear, actionable business insights and evidence based recommendations.
• Develop, maintain and enhance dashboards, reports and scorecards that are accurate and aligned with business requirements.
• Present results so that both technical and non technical audiences can act on them.
• Collect, clean, validate and prepare data for analysis and reporting.
• Identify inconsistencies, gaps and anomalies, and work with data owners to resolve data quality issues.
• Engage stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and translate these into reporting specifications and analytical outputs.
• Support the development of measurement frameworks and key performance indicators, and monitor performance metrics to highlight significant changes or emerging trends.
• Identify opportunities to improve operations and customer experience through data analysis.
• Follow data governance, privacy and security standards, and keep documentation of reports, data sources and business definitions current.
• Respond to reporting requests and provide analytical support to business users.
• Build your knowledge of analytical tools, reporting platforms and banking products through training and continuous learning.

What you need
• A relevant qualification in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Finance or a related field, preferably a Bachelor's degree
• 1 to 2 years' experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst or similar analytical role
• Experience working with Power BI, needed to build and maintain dashboards, reports and scorecards
• Experience using SQL for data extraction and analysis
• Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non technical audiences

Nice to have
• Exposure to Python, R or other analytical tools
• Experience in the banking or financial services industry

Closing date: 2026-11-05

The appointment will be made from the designated group in line with the Employment Equity Plan of Old Mutual South Africa and the specific business unit in question.
